description:
## Goal

Make compiler warnings demand-driven, supported, retractable facts. Clause coverage must have one semantic authority: the typed dispatch reachability already calculated for reached activation input rows and reached local dispatches. No source-time or whole-contract coverage pass may invent a broader domain or warm cold work.

## End-state laws

- ActivationInputs is the sole correlated input evidence for function-head coverage. A contract refines or rejects a reached row; it is never enumerated as an independent coverage domain.
- Local case and with-else coverage uses the typed values reaching that exact lowered dispatch. Receive misses remain selection behavior, not warnings.
- Warning evidence is published by the derivation that observed it, retracts when its last support disappears, and never creates semantic demand.
- Diagnostic rendering is a consumer projection over settled warning evidence plus exact source-version provenance.
- Equal reproduction is quiet. Removing a call, replacing relevant source, or retiring the owning request moves only exact dependents. Cold functions and unobserved contract alternatives do no coverage work.
- No global warning-once registry, source AST coverage walker, contract-domain sweep, duplicate dispatch plan, scan, or reconstruction pass remains.

## Signal

Quicksort is warning-free because every reached append/qsort activation is list-shaped. A reachable non-list call produces exactly one warning and removing that call retracts it. Typed case/with examples warn only when their reached subject rows can fall through. Location-only replacement updates spans without semantic or backend regeneration. Repeating an unchanged request emits the current diagnostic snapshot with zero compiler work.

## Strategy

Land vertical cutovers after the tfn source-owner, attempt, semantic-support, live-replacement, diagnostic-provenance, and product-request lifecycle foundations. Each child introduces a live final-model consumer and deletes the authority it replaces. The closeout blocks source-version reclamation so warning provenance participates in the lifetime proof before old versions can be freed.

## Existing tickets absorbed or refined

- fz-kdt.36 becomes this epic; its former policy choice is resolved in favor of demanded activation evidence.
- fz-5xp.88 remains the actionable-rendering ticket, but its undeclared-any premise must be replaced with reachable typed failure evidence.
- fz-tfn.40 supplies content/provenance separation; it does not itself own warning support or coverage semantics.
- fz-tfn.46 supplies completed attempt-owned diagnostics.
- fz-kdt.64 supplies exact withdrawal of ActivationInputs/ReturnType support.
- fz-tfn.47 supplies the retained request lifecycle through which current diagnostics are observed.

One child equals one commit and one close. Every child updates its affected agent/user docs and removes its own construction debris.
title: Demand-driven retractable warning facts: collapse clause coverage into semantic analysis
